svg.title: Denyel Chokey Namgyal. Manufacture Namgyal, calibre Integrity. Four complications around a sealed souscription dial. The aperture holds 14:42, when this account began. Only the seconds move.
svg.desc: Personal chronometer for a computer science student in Bhutan. The four satellites are HASH, SENTINEL, UNTIL THEN, and SNAKE. The secret signature is a SHA-256 prefix of his name. One red seconds hand.
svg.text: authorized web testing; reports a human can stand behind
memories held until a date you choose
a reinforcement-learning agent you can watch
